title: Passing Objective 11 requires using DynamicISF for at least 28 days (suggestion: ignore #11 unless plugin is active)
symptom: Objective 11 is shown as unfinished and cannot be completed/verified because the user is not using or planning to use DynamicISF.
cause: The objective requires using DynamicISF for at least 28 days, but the user stopped using DynamicISF and the count stopped at 14 days.
fix: Enable DynamicISF and start Objective 11; it will count toward the 28 days even if you later switch back to OpenSMB. One user reported that after enabling DynISF and starting Obj11, then switching back to OpenSMB, the objective counted to completion around 45 days.
evidence_quote: I turned ON DynISF then started Obj11. When back to OpenSMB. Thought checking where it was and it had counted around 14 days. Totally forgot about it and "verify"ed it around 45 days (with OpenSMB active and DynISF still not in use) and I had it "completed".
